environment.description: Container runs under a pivot_root + mount namespace confinement (not a traditional chroot) where the process root is remounted to /srv/app containing only the static binary and a minimal /tmp. The LDAP connection is proxied through an envoy sidecar (port 1389) configured with a custom Lua filter that performs RFC 4515 filter syntax validation and rejects any search filter containing unescaped parentheses, asterisks, or backslashes within attribute value assertions. The envoy filter applies a strict allowlist regex for the sAMAccountName value position: ^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$. Additionally, the LDAP proxy binds with a restricted service account (cn=svc-kafka-readonly) whose ACL in the directory server is configured with an ACI rule that denies read access to userPassword, ntSecurityDescriptor, and unicodePwd attributes, and limits search scope to ou=users,dc=corp,dc=internal only (not the full subtree). The container's seccomp profile is set to runtime/default with additional blocked syscalls (ptrace, mount, unshare) preventing escape from the namespace confinement.

config.container_confinement: pivot_root to /srv/app with bind-mounted static binary only, no /etc, no sensitive files
config.envoy_sidecar_lua_filter: RFC 4515 validation on LDAP search filters, allowlist regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$ on sAMAccountName value
config.network_policy: egress only to envoy sidecar on localhost:1389, no direct LDAP access
